Rav'i.overview: At 0 energy, Rav'i goes to the nearest Carrion Pile and uses Ssscavenging, shielding itself and damaging the party. The key is for the tank to pre-position it at a pile without Fresh Meat.

phases.title: Throughout
points: [참고] Ravenous Stomp damages the party and drops Fresh Meat on 2 of the 3 Carrion Piles
[회피] Dodge the stalactite puddles that fall after Ravenous Stomp; getting hit means heavy damage and a stun
[회피] Dodge the 3 Regurgitate wave lines; getting hit cuts your movement speed and damage dealt by 50%
[위치] Triple Shot targets spread loosely so the 5-yard hits don't overlap

phases.title: Ssscavenging (0 energy)
points: [참고] It eats the nearest Carrion Pile, gains an absorb shield, and repeats Carrion Burst until the shield breaks
[위치] Everyone steps on the Messy Eater meat puddles; each missed puddle adds another Carrion Burst
[참고] Eating a Fresh Meat pile triggers Feeding Frenzy: Rav'i eats twice as fast, so Carrion Burst stacks up faster
[참고] Breaking the shield ends the channel and the party damage, so focus all damage on the shield

group: [위치] During Ssscavenging, step on every Messy Eater puddle and focus damage on the shield
[참고] Healers top the party before Ravenous Stomp and use cooldowns on Ssscavenging
[회피] Dodge Regurgitate waves and falling stalactite puddles

The Writhing Coil.overview: In the main-body phase you interrupt Toxic Atrophy and dodge Vindictive Onslaught; on Death Rattle, breaking the tethers splits it into 5 Uncoiled Writhe. Damage to the Writhes carries over to the boss's health, so the split phase is your damage window.

phases.title: Phase 1 (main body)
points: [차단] Toxic Atrophy is cast 3 times in a row during Toxic Barrage; each hit stacks 20% damage and 20% movement speed reduction
[회피] Vindictive Onslaught: dodge the Burrowing Charge line toward the target, then the Venom Jet cone that follows
[참고] Synchronized Venom deals damage every second to the whole party for 35s

phases.title: Death Rattle transition
points: [위치] Death Rattle party damage keeps ramping, so pull your Vine Grip tether 10+ yards to break it immediately
[참고] Once everyone breaks their tether, the boss splits into 5 Uncoiled Writhe

phases.title: Phase 2 (Uncoil)
points: [참고] Damage to the Writhes stays on the boss's health after it re-forms, so use AoE cooldowns here
[차단] Some Writhes cast Toxic Atrophy; interrupt them or delay them with CC
[위치] If fixated by Spiteful Hunt, CC the Writhe to keep it out of melee and avoid Spiteful Venom
[회피] After about 25s the Writhes converge in the center and release an Undermining shockwave, so get out of the center

group: [차단] Set the interrupt order for the 3 Toxic Atrophy casts before the pull
[위치] Save movement abilities for Death Rattle and break your tether right away
[참고] Healers prepare for the long Synchronized Venom DoT and the ramping Death Rattle damage

Zul'jan.overview: Body-block the 4 Ritual of the Fang beams to take Ritual Venom, then clear it with physical damage like Boneslicer before it expires. Drop the blood pools this creates at the edge to keep the central beam lines clear.

phases.title: Ritual of the Fang
points: [위치] When the boss channels in the center for 8s, body-block the 4 beams coming from the four altars
[참고] Any beam that reaches the boss grants Fang Empowered, stacking up party damage
[위치] Beams always come from the same four spots, so assign positions and stand there in advance
[참고] Blocking a beam stacks Ritual Venom, which explodes if not cleared within 50s

phases.title: Throughout (between Rituals)
points: [위치] Standing in the Boneslicer target's line, the initial hit and 7s physical DoT clear all Ritual Venom stacks
[위치] Everyone takes one of the 2 Boneslicers together; the target cancels the other with a threat drop like Shadowmeld or Invisibility (Raider.IO)
[회피] Right after the Ritual, 3 spinning Axegrinder axes bounce around the room; dodge them
[위치] Drop Bloodletting blood pools at the edge and keep the central X beam lines clear

group: [위치] Assign the 4 Ritual of the Fang beam spots before the pull
[참고] Decide before the pull which Boneslicer everyone takes together
[위치] Don't drop blood pools on the central X beam lines
[참고] Healers use a cooldown on each Ritual of the Fang and spot-heal right after Ritual Venom is cleared

Lightblossom Trinity.overview: Meittik creates Fertile Loam, Lekshi plants seeds, and Kezkitt grows them with beams; 10s later Lightbloom Overgrowth erupts. The three bosses share health through Thicket's Trinity.

phases.title: Throughout (Meittik)
points: [탱버] Bedrock Slam deals heavy Nature+Physical damage to the tank and creates Fertile Loam around it.
[회피] Fertile Loam slows by 50% and deals damage over time, so don't stand in it.
[참고] On Mythic, Bedrock Slam is followed by Bedrock Surge, dealing damage over time to the whole party for 8s.

phases.title: Throughout (Lekshi)
points: [회피] Lightsower Dash charges between Fertile Loam patches, hitting allies in its path and planting Lightblossoms; dodge it.
[회피] Thornblade targets spread, then get out of the 15-yard Fan Of Thorns that follows.

phases.title: Throughout (Kezkitt)
points: [위치] Stand in the Lightblossom Beam path to block it so the flowers don't gain Light-Gorged.
[참고] The more Light-Gorged stacks, the bigger the 8s AoE damage from Lightbloom Overgrowth.
[회피] After Overgrowth, Fertile Loam turns into damaging Light-Scorched Earth; get out of it.
[차단] Interrupt Kezkitt's Light Bolt whenever you can.

group: [위치] Block Lightblossom Beam by stepping into the beam path, not in front of the flower.
[회피] Don't stand in Fertile Loam or Light-Scorched Earth.
[위치] Spread for Thornblade and get out of Lekshi's Fan Of Thorns range.

Ikuzz the Light Hunter.overview: Ikuzz roots allies with Bloodthorn Roots and at 100 energy chases one player with Bloodthirsty Gaze. From 50%, Lightcrazed Frenzy increases its damage.

phases.title: Throughout (100-50%)
points: [해제] Free allies rooted by Bloodthorn Roots by breaking the roots or using a root-removal effect.
[회피] Verdant Stomp knocks everyone back, so don't stand with your back to an edge.
[참고] On Mythic, Bloodthorn Roots erupt at every ally's position after Verdant Stomp.
[회피] The Bloodthirsty Gaze target keeps distance from the boss for 10s to avoid Incise and the 5s Crunched stun.
[위치] The Bloodthirsty Gaze target drags the boss toward the roots so Crushing Footfalls (7 yards) breaks them.
[참고] Thorncaller Roar deals Nature damage to the whole party for 6s; on Mythic, roots erupt around it.

phases.title: After 50% (Lightcrazed Frenzy)
points: [참고] Boss movement speed +20%, and Holy AoE damage every 2s until it dies.
[회피] With the boss faster, the Bloodthirsty Gaze target starts gaining distance earlier.

group: [해제] Break rooted allies' roots right away so they can move for Bloodthirsty Gaze and Verdant Stomp.
[탱버] Everyone uses a personal defensive for the Thorncaller Roar cast.
[참고] Healers save big healing cooldowns for the Frenzy phase after 50%.

Lightwarden Ruia.overview: Ruia fights in Moonkin Form until 70% and in Bear Form from 70% to 40%, then at 40% returns to Haranir form and channels Spirits of the Vale, using every ability every 8s until it dies.

phases.title: Moonkin Form
points: [차단] Interrupt Warden's Wrath, which it casts at the tank instead of melee attacks.
[회피] Lightfire targets move away so the Lightfire Beams (damage + 6s silence) that appear 6s later don't cover the party.
[회피] Dodge the Lightfall impact circles (4 yards).

phases.title: Bear Form
points: [탱버] Mangling Claws increases melee damage by 100%.
[위치] Pulverizing Strikes targets stop and aim the cone away from the party.
[참고] Grievous Thrash is a stacking bleed that only drops off at full health.

phases.title: After 40% (Haranir form)
points: [참고] During Spirits of the Vale the boss uses every ability (Lightfire, Lightfall, Pulverizing Strikes, Grievous Thrash) every 8s.
[탱버] This is the most dangerous phase, so both tank and party save defensives for it.

group: [위치] Pulverizing Strikes targets spread from each other so the cones don't overlap.
[회피] Dodge Lightfire Beams and Lightfall circles.
[참고] Save defensives and healing cooldowns for Spirits of the Vale after 40%.

Ziekket.overview: Ziekket summons Lashers with Awaken the Lightbloom and revives Lashers that went Dormant. It fights by melting Dormant corpses with Concentrated Lightbeam and absorbing Essence orbs.

phases.title: Throughout (Lashers)
points: [참고] At 1% health Lashers go Dormant, burrow, and revive on the next Awaken the Lightbloom.
[참고] Revived Lashers gain Vicious Regrowth (+30% haste and damage) and are immune to interrupts and CC.
[차단] Interrupt as many Lightspore Shots as possible before the Lashers revive.

phases.title: Throughout (Ziekket)
points: [위치] The Concentrated Lightbeam target positions so the beam passes over Dormant Lasher corpses.
[회피] Get out of the Lightsap puddles the beam leaves (damage + 40% slow).
[위치] Step on Lightbloom's Essence orbs before they reach the boss to prevent Fluorescent Outburst and its shield.
[참고] Each orb you step on stacks Lightbloom's Might (+10% damage and healing) and a 12s Holy DoT.
[탱버] Thornspike deals Holy damage and a knockback to the tank, plus a 10s physical bleed.
[참고] Oozing Xylem deals Holy damage to the whole party every 3s for the entire fight.

group: [위치] The Concentrated Lightbeam target aims the beam at Dormant Lasher corpses.
[위치] Split the Essence orbs; high stacks increase damage taken, so manage them.
[회피] Get out of Lightsap puddles.

The Hoardmonger.overview: It uses Earthshatter Slam and Ravenous Bellow, then at 100 energy scatters mushrooms with Spoiled Supplies. At 90/70/40% health it eats a resource pile to empower one ability; in Mythic+ the empowerments last the whole fight.

phases.title: Throughout
points: [회피] Earthshatter Slam is a frontal cone on a random target; if targeted, step to the side.
[참고] Ravenous Bellow is armor-ignoring physical damage to everyone plus a 10s DoT, so healers use a cooldown.
[위치] The party spreads to step on every Spoiled Supplies mushroom within 12s to prevent Putrid Burst.
[해제] Each mushroom stacks Toxic Spores poison; cleanse it with a poison dispel.

phases.title: 90/70/40% health (Resourceful Measures)
points: [위치] The boss eats the nearest resource pile, so feed it the mushroom pile last. For the first two, Method recommends meat then bone, Raider.IO bone then meat.
[참고] Eating meat turns it into Hearty Bellow, adding a knockback to the party-wide damage.
[회피] Eating bone turns it into Bonespike Slam, leaving spike puddles that slow by 50% for 45s.
[위치] Eating the mushroom pile increases the number of Spoiled Supplies mushrooms, so spread the soakers further.

group: [위치] Spread during Spoiled Supplies and step on every single mushroom.
[회피] Get out of the Earthshatter Slam and Bonespike Slam frontals and don't step on bone spike puddles.

Sentinel of Winter.overview: On an ice floor with Raging Squall tornadoes roaming, you deal with 2 Fractured Shivercores spawned by Shattering Frostspike. Frozen Tempest is party-wide damage and a push, so hold out inside a Snowdrift or the eye of the storm.

phases.title: Throughout
points: [회피] Raging Squall roams for 1m30s and deals heavy damage and a knockback on contact.
[위치] The party stacks in one spot to bait Raging Squall there, then circles the room to dodge.
[해제] Glacial Torment is a 16s frost DoT; remove it with a magic dispel.

phases.title: Shattering Frostspike (2 adds)
points: [회피] Dodge the Shattering Frostspike circles; a Fractured Shivercore spawns at each spot.
[차단] Winter's Shroud deals frost damage to everyone and stacks frost damage taken; interrupt as many as possible.
[위치] When an add dies, one player steps on the Rimeshatter within 6s to prevent Rime Detonation.
[참고] Kill the first add fast and the second right before Frozen Tempest to secure a Snowdrift.

phases.title: Frozen Tempest
points: [위치] Standing inside a Snowdrift prevents the push; if outside, get into the eye of the storm.
[참고] Inside a Snowdrift you're slowed by 40%, so check the Raging Squall path in advance.

group: [차단] Set the Winter's Shroud interrupt order for both adds in advance.
[위치] Assign one Rimeshatter soaker to step on it every time an add dies.
[위치] During Frozen Tempest, everyone gathers inside a Snowdrift or the eye of the storm.

Nalorakk.overview: Echoing Maul builds up Echoes of Nalorakk, and after Overwhelming Onslaught you soak Forceful Slam. At 100 energy, Fury of the War God sends the Echoes charging at Zul'jarra; body-block them.

phases.title: Throughout
points: [위치] The 3 Echoing Maul targets move to the edge or next to existing Echoes within 4s without overlapping allies.
[회피] Getting near an Echo hits you with a Spectral Slash knockback and a stacking DoT, so keep distance.
[참고] Each Echo goes through one more Fury of the War God before disappearing.

phases.title: Overwhelming Onslaught
points: [위치] Zul'jarra leaps behind the tank and raises a shield; everyone stands behind it to reduce damage by 80%.
[참고] Three armor-ignoring physical hits are followed by a party-wide knockback, so healers prepare AoE healing.
[탱버] Right after the knockback, Forceful Slam lands on Zul'jarra, so the tank gets within 6m to take it.

phases.title: Fury of the War God (100 energy)
points: [위치] The whole party surrounds Zul'jarra in the middle, standing in the Echo charge paths.
[참고] Each Echo you block deals Echoing Fury nature damage, so rotate defensives.
[참고] Any Echo that reaches Zul'jarra triggers Demoralizing Scream, dealing party damage and stacking 10% damage taken.

group: [위치] Stack Echoes of Nalorakk on one edge so they're easy to block during Fury of the War God.
[위치] During Overwhelming Onslaught, everyone stands behind Zul'jarra's shield.
[위치] During Fury of the War God, form a wall around Zul'jarra and body-block the Echoes.

Kystia Manaheart.overview: Kystia takes 80% less damage from 4 stacks of Felshield, so repeatedly bring Nibbles to 20% to trigger Destabilized. Stack damage and healing cooldowns into each 20s Destabilized window.

phases.title: Throughout
points: [참고] At the start, Kystia takes 80% reduced damage from 4 stacks of Felshield.
[참고] Bringing Nibbles to 20% applies Destabilized, making Kystia take 115% increased damage.
[회피] Nibbles' Fel Spray is a rotating frontal; dodge it.
[회피] When Kystia teleports to a random player and casts Fel Nova, get out of range.
[차단] The 5 clones from Mirror Images cast Felstorm; interrupt or CC all of them.
[해제] Corroding Spittle is a 30s magic DoT; dispel the most endangered target first.
[탱버] Chaos Barrage hits the tank first, then bounces to nearby party members.

phases.title: Destabilized window (4 times in M+)
points: [참고] During the 20s of Destabilized the party takes heavy DoT damage, so use defensives and healing cooldowns.
[참고] DPS stack their damage cooldowns into this window on Kystia.

group: [참고] Bring Nibbles to 20% first, then use damage cooldowns when Destabilized is up.
[차단] Stop all 5 Mirror Images' Felstorm with interrupts and CC.
[해제] Healers dispel Corroding Spittle quickly; if you meet a clone while affected, use a defensive.

Zaen Bladesorrow.overview: Barrels keep dropping into the room: clear Fel-Infused Freight with Fire Bomb, and hide behind Forbidden Freight during Murder in a Row. The tank endures Envenom and Heartstop Poison.

phases.title: Throughout
points: [회피] Dodge barrels dropped by Same-Day Delivery and the Freight Explosion area.
[위치] Fire Bomb targets move away from the party and position so it detonates Fel-Infused Freight.
[참고] Fel-Infused Freight deals DoT damage to the party while it remains, so clear it first.
[회피] Before the Murder in a Row cast ends, hide behind Forbidden Freight, one player per barrel.
[참고] Getting hit by Murder in a Row means heavy damage and a long bleed.
[참고] Killing Spree is armor-ignoring party AoE damage, so stay topped up.
[탱버] Envenom triggers Heartstop Poison on the tank, reducing max health by 30%.

group: [회피] During Murder in a Row, only one player hides per barrel.
[참고] Clear Fel-Infused Freight with Fire Bomb first, and let Murder in a Row take care of the rest.
[참고] Healers use healing cooldowns when Killing Spree overlaps with Fel-Infused Freight.

Xathuux the Annihilator.overview: The tank holds the boss at the edge of the circular arena facing outward, and axes from Axe Toss get broken quickly next to the boss. During Demonic Rage, circle slowly while laying Burning Steps puddles.

phases.title: Throughout
points: [탱버] Legion Strike deals heavy damage and applies a strong 8s healing reduction.
[위치] Axe Toss targets come into melee range next to the boss to drop the axe.
[참고] Axes deal stacking Fel Lightning damage until destroyed, so swap immediately and break them.
[회피] Spread loosely and use a defensive before Infernal Crush.

phases.title: Demonic Rage
points: [참고] Demonic Rage deals AoE damage at the end of its cast and increases the boss's damage taken by 30%.
[회피] During this time the boss leaves Burning Steps puddles; don't step on them.
[참고] DPS line up damage cooldowns with Demonic Rage.

group: [위치] Axe Toss targets drop the axe next to the boss, and all DPS swap to it.
[회피] Spread loosely for Infernal Crush, and use a defensive if an axe is still alive.
[회피] Don't step on Burning Steps puddles.

Lithiel Cinderfury.overview: Lithiel pressures with Chaos Bolt and summons while an unkillable Infernal chases the tank the whole fight. When Lithiel teleports through a Demonic Gateway, take the gate after Malefic Wave passes.

phases.title: Throughout
points: [차단] Chaos Bolt deals heavy damage to a random target; interrupt it as top priority.
[참고] The tank picks up the Furious Vilefiend from Summon Vilefiend and it dies fast.
[회피] Spread for Fingers of Gul'dan but overlap the circles slightly to group the Wild Imps.
[차단] Stop the Wild Imps' Felfire Burst with interrupts/CC and AoE them down fast.
[참고] Searing Fel Flame deals constant damage to the party the whole fight.

phases.title: Demonic Gateway / Malefic Wave
points: [회피] When Lithiel teleports, take the gate after Malefic Wave passes the opposite gate.
[참고] Demons touched by Malefic Wave gain Malefic Empowerment, so kill all adds before the wave.
[참고] The teleported Lithiel is protected by Felshield; attack after reaching the landing spot.
[참고] Getting hit by Malefic Wave applies a DoT and 50% fire damage vulnerability.

group: [차단] Set the Chaos Bolt interrupt order in advance.
[회피] Cross Malefic Wave via the Demonic Gateway, and kill all adds before crossing.
[회피] Overlap Fingers of Gul'dan circles only slightly and don't step inside each other's circle.

Taz'Rah.overview: It cycles through Ethereal Shades' Nether Dash, then Umbral Rupture laying Void Fissures, then Dark Bloom bursting orbs out of the Fissures. The tank takes Void Blast knockbacks while rotating the boss along the wall.

phases.title: Throughout: Nether Dash → Umbral Rupture
points: [위치] When Ethereal Shades appear, start moving the boss away from the Shades.
[회피] Aim Nether Dash toward the wall, and don't stand in other players' Nether Dash lines.
[위치] Before Umbral Rupture, stack loosely near the wall to drop the Void Fissures together along the wall.
[회피] Umbral Rupture damages players within 10 yards of a Void Fissure, so get out immediately.

phases.title: Throughout: Dark Bloom
points: [참고] Dark Bloom deals heavy shadow damage to the whole party and bursts orbs out of every Void Fissure.
[위치] Before Dark Bloom, move the boss and party well away from the Void Fissures.
[회피] Orbs flying out of Void Fissures are lethal; don't get hit by a single one.

group: [위치] Nether Dash targets stand loosely grouped near the wall (without overlapping each other's Nether Dash lines) to group the Umbral Rupture puddles.
[참고] Healers top the party before Umbral Rupture and use healing cooldowns on Dark Bloom.

Atroxus.overview: While dodging Poison Splash puddles and the Noxious Breath frontal, the tank kites the Toxic Creeper spawned by each Monstrous Roar and DPS kill it fast. If the Creeper's Sickening Bite stacks up, Hulking Claw kills the tank.

phases.title: Throughout: boss abilities
points: [탱버] Hulking Claw deals heavy nature damage and a 10s nature DoT to the tank after a 2s cast.
[회피] Noxious Breath is a big nature frontal in the boss's facing direction; step to its side.
[회피] Stepping in the Poison Pool left after Poison Splash applies Mind-Numbing Poison (-30% haste).

phases.title: Monstrous Roar → Toxic Creeper
points: [참고] Monstrous Roar deals heavy physical damage to the whole party and summons a Toxic Creeper.
[참고] While alive, the Toxic Creeper's Toxic Aura damages the whole party every 0.5s.
[회피] The Toxic Creeper fixates the tank and applies one Sickening Bite stack per melee hit.
[참고] Sickening Bite increases nature damage taken by 50% (5 min, stacking) and can't be dispelled.

group: [참고] DPS swap immediately when a Toxic Creeper spawns and kill it as top priority.
[참고] Healers use healing cooldowns on Monstrous Roar and while the Toxic Creeper is alive.
[회피] Check the Noxious Breath direction, stay close to the boss, and step briefly to the side.

Charonus.overview: After 3 Unstable Singularities spawn, drag Gravitic Orbs into a Singularity to destroy them while dodging Cosmic Crash and Void Cascade. The tank keeps the boss in the middle of the Singularities and turns Dark Waves away from the party.

phases.title: Throughout: Unstable Singularity
points: [참고] Unstable Singularity deals DoT damage to the whole party the entire fight and slowly pulls players in.
[회피] Touching a Singularity applies Atomized, blocking damage and healing for 15s, so never go in.

phases.title: Recurring abilities
points: [회피] DPS fixated by Gravitic Orbs drag the orb into an Unstable Singularity to destroy it.
[참고] Condensed Mass applies a stacking shadow DoT and a slow until the orb is gone.
[위치] Cosmic Crash hits each player's position with an 8-yard explosion, knockback, and 20s DoT, so spread out.
[회피] Void Cascade targets run away from the boss, and everyone else gets out of the projectile path.

group: [위치] Before Gravitic Orbs, stand next to your nearest Singularity and split assignments with pings.
[참고] Healers use cooldowns for Cosmic Crash burst and 20s DoT, and for spot-healing Condensed Mass targets.

The Golden Serpent.overview: Spit Gold builds up Molten Gold pools on the floor, and on Lucre's Call each pool awakens an Animated Gold that runs to the boss. The tank keeps the boss away from the gold while the party controls and AoEs the adds.

phases.title: Throughout
points: [탱버] Tail Thrash is a tank-targeted ability, so have mitigation up for every cast
[위치] Spit Gold targets drop Molten Gold against a wall far from the boss or next to existing pools
[위치] Don't drop pools in the central space the tank circles through or in the tank's path ahead
[참고] Lucre's Call summons an Animated Gold from each new Molten Gold pool
[위치] Each Animated Gold that reaches the boss adds 1 Luster stack (shield + 25% damage)
[회피] Serpentine Gust deals AoE damage and a knockback, so don't stand with your back to a pool

group: [위치] Slow and CC the Animated Gold and AoE it down as top priority to keep it off the boss
[참고] Assign healer cooldowns and personal defensives to Serpentine Gust
[참고] Spit Gold's 6s DoT hits hard, so targets use a defensive if needed

Mchimba the Embalmer.overview: Two Half-Finished Mummies awaken along with Awakening Slam's AoE damage. If the party is slow to find a player trapped by Entomb, a Finished Mummy spawns each time the boss opens another coffin.

phases.title: Throughout
points: [차단] Interrupt Wretched Discharge from the 2 Half-Finished Mummies that spawn after the Awakening Slam AoE
[회피] Drain Fluids deals heavy damage to one player and leaves Explosive Acids pools; dodge the pools
[참고] When Drain Fluids ends, Desiccation is applied and only drops once you're healed above 90%
[위치] Burn Corruption targets drop Burning Ground at the back of the room or against the front wall
[참고] The Entomb target is trapped in one of 4 coffins and spams the Struggle button to shake it
[위치] The party finds and clicks the shaking coffin; if too slow, each opened coffin spawns a Finished Mummy
[차단] Finished Mummies only cast Wretched Discharge too, so interrupt them as soon as they spawn

group: [참고] Awakening Slam is heavy party AoE, so prepare a healer cooldown or burst healing
[참고] The Drain Fluids target uses a defensive and healers focus-heal that target
[위치] Keep the central aisle clear and run straight to the coffins on Entomb

The Council of Tribes.overview: You face them one at a time: Kula, Aka'ali, then Zanazal. Kula's Whirling Axes and Aka'ali's Barrel Through keep coming even after that boss dies.

phases.title: Kula the Butcher
points: [회피] Get out of the Whirling Axes spawn point, then move into the gaps between axes
[참고] Severing Axe deals heavy damage and an 8s bleed to one player, so the target uses a defensive

phases.title: Aka'ali the Conqueror
points: [위치] The Barrel Through target stands in the middle of the room and everyone stacks within 7 yards to soak
[탱버] Debilitating Backhand knocks back and applies 10s Shattered Defenses (increased physical damage taken)

phases.title: Zanazal the Wise
points: [차단] Poison Nova is a heavy 12s poison DoT, so always interrupt it
[참고] Arc Lightning hits the tank, then bounces to nearby party members
[위치] Kill the Call of the Elements totems in this order: Explosive Totem, Thundering Totem, Torrent Totem
[참고] Thundering Totem's Disruption interrupts anyone casting, so watch its cast bar

group: [위치] Barrel Through keeps coming after Aka'ali dies, so keep stacking in the middle to soak
[위치] Kill Explosive Totem as top priority before its Explode cast
[참고] Severing Axe targets use a defensive and healers focus-heal the bleeding target

Dazar, The First King.overview: The fight starts with Dazar and Reban together; kill Reban first. At 80% Dazar mounts T'zala, sharing damage and adding Savage Maul and Quaking Leap.

phases.title: Phase 1 (100-80%, Reban)
points: [차단] Interrupt Reban's Deathly Roar (fear) every time and kill Reban first
[회피] Get out of the frontal attack that follows Reban's Hunting Leap landing
[위치] Aerial Smash leaps to 2 players and hits within 8 yards, so stay apart

phases.title: Phase 2 (below 80%, riding T'zala)
points: [참고] Dazar and T'zala share damage through Eternal Bond, so keep attacking Dazar only
[탱버] T'zala's Savage Maul (bleed + vulnerability) is followed immediately by Blade Combo
[위치] Quaking Leap leaps to 4 players and hits the whole party with damage that falls off with distance from the landing spot, so spread

phases.title: Throughout
points: [회피] Watch the Impaling Spear swirl pattern on the floor and move to a safe spot before the spears land
[참고] Gilded Destruction is the hardest-hitting part: burst AoE damage followed by a 15s party DoT
[위치] During Gilded Destruction the boss's melee becomes a Searing Gold frontal flame, so don't stand in front of it

group: [참고] Line up big healer cooldowns, personal defensives, and potions with Gilded Destruction
[참고] The chain of Quaking Leaps can be stopped by the farthest target using an ability that drops combat
[위치] Keep checking which way the boss and raptor are facing as you move

Melidrussa Chillworn.overview: Frigid Shard, Hailburst, and Chillstorm repeat, with whelp-summon and shield-break intermissions at 66% and 33%.

phases.title: Throughout
points: [차단] Interrupt the tank-targeted Frigid Shard (2.5s cast) every time.
[회피] Hailburst leaves Hailbombs ice at each player's position, so stack to drop them in one spot and move around the room.
[회피] Touching Hailbombs ice deals heavy Nature damage, knocks you upward and reduces haste by 50% for 20s.
[위치] Chillstorm targets are kept outside the party and walk against the pull toward the center.
[회피] Chillstorm explodes after 7s and pushes you out, so make sure there are no Hailbombs behind you.

phases.title: Intermission (66% / 33%)
points: [참고] When Awaken Whelps spawns several Infused Whelps, the tank picks them all up.
[참고] The boss gains Ice Bulwark and channels Frost Overload; focus damage to break the shield.
[참고] Frost Overload deals party damage every 1.5s and stacks 5% increased damage taken.

group: [차단] The whole party sets the Frigid Shard interrupt order in advance.
[참고] Healers use healing cooldowns for the Chillstorm explosion and Frost Overload.

Kokia Blazehoof.overview: Kokia summons a Blazebound Firestorm at every 100 energy, while Molten Boulder and the tank-targeted Searing Blows repeat in between.

phases.title: Throughout
points: [참고] At 100 energy, Ritual of Blazebinding summons a Blazebound Firestorm at the target's position.
[회피] The initial Ritual of Blazebinding impact is 12-yard fire damage, so the target moves away from the party.
[위치] The target places the Firestorm close to the boss where it won't sweep the party.
[참고] When the Blazebound Firestorm spawns, swap to it immediately.
[차단] Interrupt the Firestorm's Blaze Volley (3.5s, party fire damage) every time.
[회피] Molten Boulder smashes 6 yards in front, rolls 40 yards, explodes for 12 yards, and leaves Scorched Earth.
[회피] The boulder can hit a small rock and explode early, so give its path a wide berth.
[위치] Circle slowly in one direction to keep room to move.

group: [차단] Set the Blaze Volley interrupt order before the Firestorm spawns.
[참고] Healers prepare healing cooldowns for the Firestorm's Inferno party damage.
[회피] Dodge the Molten Boulder path and the Scorched Earth on the floor.

Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein.overview: In phase 1 Kyrakka flies around while Erkhart fights on the ground. When either boss reaches 50% (Raider.IO: Erkhart at 40%), Erkhart mounts Kyrakka and phase 2 begins.

phases.title: Phase 1
points: [참고] Kyrakka flies around while Erkhart uses Stormslam on the tank on the ground.
[위치] The 2 Inferno Spit targets move outside the party to drop the fire puddles.
[회피] Kyrakka lands near a random player and breathes a Roaring Firebreath frontal; dodge it.
[참고] Focus damage on Kyrakka while she's down to kill the dragon first.

phases.title: Throughout
points: [참고] Stop casting before Interrupting Cloudburst (5s cast) ends to avoid the 2s lockout.
[위치] Winds of Change blows northwest, southwest, southeast, then northeast, pushing players and fire puddles.
[위치] Check the next wind direction and place Inferno Spit puddles so they get pushed away from the party.

phases.title: Phase 2 (50%)
points: [참고] When either boss reaches 50% (Raider.IO: Erkhart at 40%), Erkhart mounts Kyrakka and phase 2 begins.
[위치] In phase 2 Inferno Spit targets 3 players, so targets spread wider.
[참고] Save damage, healing, and defensive cooldowns for phase 2.

group: [해제] Healers dispel the tank's Stormslam debuff before the next Stormslam.
[참고] Focus Kyrakka to kill the dragon first.
[참고] Nobody casts near the end of the Interrupting Cloudburst cast.

Adderis & Aspix.overview: The two bosses pass Storm Blessed immunity back and forth, so only attack the one without it. If Adderis dies first, Aspix gains Frenzy and its ability timers speed up.

phases.title: Throughout
points: [위치] Only attack the boss without Storm Blessed, and swap immediately when the buff moves.
[회피] Gale Force pushes everyone hard in the direction they're standing, so spread loosely and avoid getting pushed into walls.
[위치] Right after Gale Force, stack in melee to split Thunder and Lightning, then get out of the big follow-up circles.
[위치] The 2 Tempest Winds targets leave the group and overlap their puddles in one spot in the middle of the room.

phases.title: Shield swap (40%)
points: [참고] Aspix starts immune; at 40% on Adderis, the immunity moves to Adderis.
[참고] When Aspix reaches 40%, the immunity returns to Aspix.

phases.title: After Adderis dies
points: [참고] Aspix loses immunity, but Frenzy speeds up the Gust, Gale Force, and Tempest Winds timers.
[위치] With more frequent abilities, move the boss to a spot with room for knockbacks and puddles ready.

group: [참고] Healers focus-heal Gust targets and top the party before Thunder and Lightning.
[회피] Don't get pushed by Gale Force into Tempest Winds puddles or other mob packs.

Merektha.overview: You deal with Lightning Bite and snake adds; at 100 energy it calls adds with Hatch and Burrows. It returns once all summoned adds are dead.

phases.title: Ground phase
points: [위치] The 2 A Knot of Snakes targets stack in melee to be freed with AoE CC, then AoE the snakes down.
[회피] Thunder Spit targets move to the outer ring of the room to drop Lingering Storm puddles at the edge.
[회피] During Serpentstorm AoE damage, position so you don't get pushed into puddles.
[탱버] Lightning Bite is a tank buster with instant damage plus a DoT, so use a defensive every time.

phases.title: Hatch/Burrow (100 energy)
points: [참고] 3 Toxic Vipers and 1 Storm Serpent spawn; Burrow only ends when all are dead.
[회피] The Burrow charge along the dust trail stuns and is lethal at high keys, so always dodge it.
[차단] Interrupt the Toxic Vipers' Poison Spit and cleanse the DoT with a poison dispel.
[참고] The Storm Serpent has twice the health of a Toxic Viper, so start AoE damage on it first.

group: [참고] Healers use major healing cooldowns for Serpentstorm AoE damage.
[참고] Killing the Hatch adds ends the phase, so focus damage on the adds.

Galvazzt.overview: 3 Lightning Spires fire beams at the boss; any that aren't blocked fill the boss's energy, and Consume Charge wipes the group. Move the boss every time an Induction puddle appears.

phases.title: Throughout
points: [위치] When the 3 Lightning Spires activate, DPS and healers stand between the boss and the spires to block the beams.
[참고] Blocking a beam stacks the Galvanized debuff, so rotate soakers while cycling defensives.
[참고] At 100 energy Consume Charge is effectively a wipe, so don't miss a single beam.
[회피] Induction deals party AoE damage and then leaves an Induction Field under the boss; get out immediately.
[위치] Assign soakers and backups for all 3 spire directions before the pull.

group: [참고] Healers focus-heal beam soakers and top the party before Induction.
[참고] If you're low when Induction hits, use a health potion to avoid dying.

Avatar of Sethraliss.overview: Killing the Essence Defiler first removes Defiling Taint and opens a 30s healing window. The fight ends when the healer heals the Avatar to 100%.

phases.title: Phase 1 (Essence Defiler alive)
points: [참고] Ignore the Avatar and kill the Essence Defiler, which applies Defiling Taint, as top priority.
[탱버] Corrupted Guardian's Tainted Strike deals heavy damage plus a stacking DoT, so use a defensive.
[위치] After the Corrupted Guardian dies, soak the 3 Corrupted Lifeforce before they erupt after 12s (Raider.IO: 2 DPS; Icy Veins: one per player).
[차단] Always interrupt Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock.
[회피] Latent Hex targets move to the back edge of the room and don't step on Hex Muck puddles.

phases.title: Phase 2 (30s after the Defiler dies)
points: [참고] The healer heals the Avatar while everyone else handles the incoming Faithless Tormentors.
[위치] Faithless Tormentors fixate the healer, so hold them with CC and AoE them down.
[참고] Each Faithless Tormentor death heals the Avatar, so the faster you kill them the better.
[회피] Dodge the Agony of Sethraliss floor puddles.

group: [참고] Soaking Corrupted Lifeforce applies Corruption (33% less healing done, 250% more Physical damage taken for 15s, stacking), so DPS take them.
[참고] Missing an orb triggers Corruption Burst, so assign the soakers before the pull (Raider.IO: 2 DPS; Icy Veins: one per player).
[참고] Healers prepare for Hex Muck AoE damage when Latent Hex is dispelled or expires.

rows.label: Magic
rows.whoAll: Most healers (Priest, Holy Paladin, Restoration Druid, Mistweaver Monk, Restoration Shaman, Preservation Evoker)

rows.label: Bleed
rows.whoAll: Paladin {Blessing of Protection} (not on the tank)

dispel.note: Druids, Monks, and others can dispel different types depending on spec. Check the in-game tooltip.
